afterglow.completedSummary: Jesus commands his followers to love one another as he has loved them.
afterglow.relatedSummary: Jesus identifies love for one's neighbor as one of the greatest commandments.
afterglow.title: A command that moves toward people.
afterglow.caution: Illustrative, author-written discovery note. Scripture references and teaching copy require editorial review before any church-wide release.
afterglow.prompt: What does John 15:12 share with another teaching of Jesus?
afterglow.label: LOVE IN ACTION
afterglow.body: Both passages place love at the center of how people treat one another. John 15:12 focuses on Jesus' love as the pattern; Mark 12:31 names love for one's neighbor as a central command.
